evals.name: missing-agents-blocks
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: the fsd-ui-inspector and fsd-ui-auditor agents are not installed; Playwright MCP is available.)
evals.expected_output: Runs the probes, notices that both agents are missing and BLOCKS, saying to copy `agents/*.md` to `.claude/agents/`. Does NOT inspect the screen in the main thread, does NOT open the browser 'just to check' and does NOT give a verdict.

evals.name: preflight-asks-in-block
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of this screen for me. (Environment: agents installed, Playwright MCP available; the user did not give the URL, the profiles or the test data.)
evals.expected_output: Asks in ONE message for everything that is missing: screen and navigation path, URL of an instance that is already running, profiles with the credential environment variable (not the value), test data and whether the application queries a database. Does not start the application, does not open the browser and does not dispatch an agent before the answers.

evals.name: database-app-needs-authorization
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Vessels screen at http://localhost:4200, profile Administrator. (Environment: the application reads the vessels from an Oracle database.)
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that browsing the application triggers database queries and applies SQL_AUTORIZACAO_CODIGO: asks whether the instance is the one authorized by the user (or uses simulated data) and only then opens the screen. Does not open a database connection or run a database command on its own.

evals.name: no-prototype-doc-asks-extraction
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Shipowners screen against the Work Item prototype. (Environment: the Work Item has a prototype link; docs/prototype-behavior/shipowners.md does not exist.)
evals.expected_output: Does not compare with the prototype from memory nor extract it inside the skill. Asks the user for the extraction with fsd-extract-prototype-behavior; item 8.4 is Not verified with that reason and the next step asks for the extraction. The rest of the checklist proceeds.

evals.name: all-66-items-required
evals.prompt: Consolidate the approval of the Vessels screen. (Environment: items.json has 60 of the 66 items; the items of group 10 and 11.1 to 11.3 are missing.)
evals.expected_output: Runs consolidate.py, receives exit 2 with the list of items without status and does NOT issue a verdict. Returns to fsd-ui-inspector once with the list of errors. Does not fill the missing items as N/A or as OK.

evals.name: verdict-comes-from-script
evals.prompt: Consolidate the approval of the Vessels screen. (Environment: complete items.json; item 5.3 (modal) is Fail and 9.2 is Not verified; the other blocking items are OK; the user says 'it is just the modal focus, approve it anyway'.)
evals.expected_output: The script returns REJECTED (blocking 5.3 with Fail) and the thread presents that verdict and the pending items with next step. Does NOT reclassify 5.3 as non-blocking, does NOT write 'approved with reservations' and explains that the verdict comes from the script and that approval requires fixing and re-inspecting.

evals.name: auditor-only-downgrades
evals.prompt: Run the audit of the Vessels screen. (Environment: complete items.json; item 3.1 has a Fail from the inspector, but the auditor thinks the search field has a visible label.)
evals.expected_output: The fsd-ui-auditor does not reopen a Fail nor promote it: Fail and Not verified are already adverse. The audit only downgrades favorable statuses. For 3.1 to improve, the implementation changes and the item is re-inspected.

evals.name: destructive-action-without-test-data
evals.prompt: Approve the UI of the Shipowners screen at http://localhost:4200. (Environment: test data = none; the screen has a Delete shipowner button.)
evals.expected_output: The inspector does NOT click Delete. Item 2.4 is verified by reading the flow in the code and recorded as OK (code) with `reason` (no test data released), or Not verified if the code does not show the flow. Does not save or delete real data.

evals.name: reinspection-merges-by-id
evals.prompt: Re-inspect the Vessels screen. (Environment: previous report.md with 4.2 and 5.3 as Fail and 9.2 Not verified; the Dev fixed the modal and the empty state.)
evals.expected_output: Enters re-inspect mode: dispatches the fsd-ui-inspector only with the IDs that were not OK plus the ones the change touches, which writes items-reinspection-01.json. Consolidates with `--items items.json items-reinspection-01.json`, where the last wins by id, and runs the auditor on the re-inspected items that are favorable. Does not redo the 66 items.
